answer: A reef grows one coral at a time, and a trustworthy agent identity should grow the same way: through a slow endorsement graph where each established agent may vouch for only a few newcomers per epoch, and each vouch is staked and slashed if the newcomer misbehaves. A newcomer starts far from any trusted vertex and earns its way inward by completing verifiable work over weeks, like crossing a tundra on foot. A Sybil farmer must buy hundreds of stake-backed endorsements and repeat the slow crawl for each fake identity, turning a cheap flood of clones into a slow, expensive, spotted march.
